item.title: Arcfront Hits $1B Run Rate After Raising Under $2M
item.description:
Arcfront has launched with a business built on turning step-by-step expert decision records from doctors, engineers and bankers into training data for frontier AI models, sourced through 300+ enterprise partnerships. The company says four of the five frontier labs already pay for this data and that it reached a $1B annual revenue run rate in under a year after raising less than $2M. Its thesis: the web barely records how senior experts actually decide, and such proprietary decision traces are far harder to replicate than scraped data.

原文标题：Arcfront 融资不足 200 万美元 年化收入破 10 亿美元

Why it matters：以专家决策轨迹作为前沿模型训练数据的新供给模式，并给出 4/5 前沿实验室付费与 10 亿美元年化收入的强量级信号。

item.title: Spotify Founder Daniel Ek Backs AI Researcher's Fusion Startup
item.description:
Spotify founder Daniel Ek has backed Europa Fusion, a UK-based fusion startup founded in February by Nantas Nardelli, a former Google DeepMind, Meta AI and Microsoft Research scientist who most recently led machine learning at Pacific Fusion. The move marks AI talent flowing into energy infrastructure, though the startup's technical approach and product details remain undisclosed.

原文标题：Spotify 创始人投资 AI 研究员创立的核聚变公司

Why it matters：AI 顶尖研究员转向核聚变创业并获知名天使投资，反映 AI 人才与资本向能源基础设施外溢的趋势。

item.description:
Signal now blocks screenshots outright on iOS 27 and triggers protection on supported Android versions when an AI assistant attempts to access the screen, aiming to stop OS-level AI agents from pulling decrypted messages off the display and bypassing end-to-end encryption. Signal told Reuters the move addresses an \\

item.title: Google and Johns Hopkins Unveil Pro2 Agent That Tracks Bottlenecks Before Coding
item.description:
Google and Johns Hopkins researchers introduce Pro2 Agent, which has ML research agents first build a 'Problem State' capturing suspected bottlenecks, candidate fixes and confidence levels, then run single-variable experiments to update beliefs before committing code changes. It reaches a 76.0% medal rate across all 75 MLE-Bench tasks within 48 hours, the highest reported, and medals on 57.6% of MLE-Bench Lite tasks with its first solution versus 28.8% for MARS.

原文标题：谷歌新研究让科研智能体先记录瓶颈再改代码

Why it matters：提出可复用的科研智能体方法论并在权威基准上刷新最高成绩，对构建研究型 Agent 的开发者有直接借鉴价值。

item.title: Anthropic Researcher Claims Lean-Verified Proof of Riemann Hypothesis
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge has published an essay claiming a Lean-compilable proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, an open problem since 1859 and one of the Clay Millennium Prize problems. Mathematicians are scrutinizing the result in Lean community channels, while a second researcher has also claimed an independent proof, leaving verification to peer review. If it holds, the result would mark a landmark intersection of mathematics and AI-assisted formal verification.

原文标题：Anthropic 员工宣称用 Lean 攻克 167 年黎曼猜想

Why it matters：黎曼猜想的 Lean 形式化证明若被证实，将是数学史与 AI 形式化验证的双重里程碑，值得所有关注前沿的读者优先分配注意力。

item.title: Winedroid Demo Runs Android Apps via WebAssembly
item.description:
Winedroid is an experimental project that attempts to run Android applications without an Android OS by leveraging WebAssembly, and it has released an interactive demo. The demo currently crashes with a runtime error when opening an APK, indicating the project remains at an early, unstable stage.

item.title: GrapheneOS Accuses Google of Pressuring OEMs and Threatening Pixel Bootloader Lockdown
item.description:
The GrapheneOS team has publicly accused Google of trying to harm and wipe out the project, alleging that Google contacted Android OEMs to ask whether they work with GrapheneOS and threatened those brands. The team also warned that Google could start locking the bootloader on Pixel devices, cutting off third-party ROM flashing. All claims currently come from GrapheneOS alone, with no formal response from Google.

原文标题：GrapheneOS 指控 Google 施压 OEM 并威胁锁死 Pixel 引导程序

Why it matters：涉及 Android 生态开放性与定制系统生存空间，对关注移动端开源与平台治理的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Google Gemini Adds Background Computer Use on Mac
item.description:
Google has launched a Computer Use feature in the Gemini Mac app that lets users describe a goal and have Gemini complete multistep tasks across local files, desktop apps, and websites inside an isolated background window, keeping the screen and cursor free. It rolls out in English in the US today, with per-app permissions, live step previews, pause controls, and pre-approval for key actions.

item.title: METR Updates AI Task-Horizon Plot with Open-Ended Benchmarks
item.description:
AI evaluation nonprofit METR has updated its widely cited time-horizon plot, adding longer and more open-ended tasks. The trend of frontier models doubling the length of tasks they can complete roughly every four months appears to hold, but models remain weaker on judgment-heavy work than on coding. METR cautions that open-ended evaluation is still far from settling whether, or how fast, automated AI R&D might arrive.

原文标题：METR 更新 AI 任务时长图 新增开放式任务评估

Why it matters：METR 任务时长曲线是衡量 AI 能力进展的关键标尺，此次更新引入开放式任务，直接影响对自动化研发时间表的判断。

item.title: Perceptron Releases 36B Robot Model Checkpoints on Hugging Face
item.description:
Perceptron AI has released ready-to-run checkpoints of its 36B-parameter robot model on Hugging Face and LeRobot, each pre-fine-tuned for a specific robot arm. Owners of supported arms can download the matching checkpoint, drive the robot with plain-text instructions, and further fine-tune for their own tasks, signaling a pretrained-checkpoint economy emerging in robotics.

原文标题：Perceptron 开源 360 亿参数机器人模型检查点

Why it matters：机器人领域首次出现大规模参数模型的开箱即用检查点分发，直接复用语言模型的生态模式，对具身智能开发者有实际可用价值。

item.title: Anthropic Shares Fall 11% After IPO as Nasdaq Erases 2026 Gains

The Nasdaq Composite dropped over 3%, erasing all of its 2026 gains, while the S&P 500 slid nearly 2% for a sixth straight losing session and entered correction territory, down 10% from its recent high, with CoreWeave, Nvidia and Oracle also selling off.

item.title: Parallel Search Tops AI Search Index at $0.014 per Task
item.description:

Both modes gained 8-9 points since August, with fast mode costing just $0.014 per task and both hitting 89 F1 on DeepSearchQA.

item.title: Space Data Center Chip Financing Faces Collateral Hurdles
item.description:
Building data centers in space runs into a structural financing obstacle: the data center ecosystem relies on debt backed by chips as collateral, but chips orbiting at 17,500 mph cannot be repossessed and resold. Lenders behind SpaceX's $40 billion chip financing deal have asked to exclude in-orbit chips. Meanwhile SpaceX and Tesla are pursuing a US-based Terrafab foundry, which has yet to break ground.

原文标题：太空数据中心芯片融资面临抵押难题

Why it matters：揭示太空算力热潮背后被忽视的金融基础设施约束，是算力扩张叙事中的关键反面视角。

item.title: Claude Helps Anthropic Mathematician Prove Riemann Hypothesis
item.description:
Anthropic mathematician Alpöge claims he and Claude have proved the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis, with Claude proposing a key step in advanced areas he had not mastered and the pair formalizing the full argument as machine-checkable code in about six weeks. If confirmed, it marks the first substantive AI contribution to a top-tier open mathematical problem.

原文标题：Claude 协助 Anthropic 数学家证明黎曼猜想

Why it matters：AI 首次被声称攻克顶级数学未解难题，且以机器可验证形式呈现，具备里程碑意义。

item.title: Stanford-led Study Finds 27B Open Model Can Self-Improve by Editing Its Own Weights
item.description:
A new paper from Stanford and other top labs shows a 27B open model can improve itself without training or gradients: Qwen3.5-27B was given access to its own weights, graded practice answers and a Python session with gradients blocked, then reasoned over hidden states for completed versus truncated answers and weakened the direction separating them. On 490 held-out problems fixed in advance, accuracy rose from 57.2% to 63.8%, while the 2B model made no edit and the 4B and 9B models degraded themselves.

原文标题：斯坦福等机构发现 27B 开源模型可自主编辑权重自我提升

Why it matters：提出无需梯度与训练的权重自编辑范式，并在开源模型上给出可验证的提升与规模效应证据，对模型后训练与部署迭代路线有直接参考价值。

item.title: PostgreSQL 19 Ships IGNORE NULLS and JSONPath Transformations
item.description:
PostgreSQL 19 was released on November 19, 2026, adding IGNORE NULLS, get-or-create inserts, JSON export, JSONPath transformations and range subtraction to its SQL surface, alongside maintenance and replication improvements. Official hands-on browser examples cover logical subscribers and physical standbys, and extension authors gain new planner hooks and shared-memory registration changes.

原文标题：PostgreSQL 19 发布 新增 IGNORE NULLS 与 JSONPath 转换

Why it matters：主流开源数据库年度大版本更新，SQL 新特性与复制改进对后端与数据工程读者具备直接可用价值。

item.title: 彭博分析千万岗位 AI 暴露职位降幅高 10 个百分点

item.title: Navier-Stokes 有限时间爆破论文完成 Lean 4 形式化
item.description:
数学家 L. Alpöge 与 T. Buckmaster 公开其 Navier-Stokes 方程有限时间爆破论文的配套 Lean 4 形式化仓库，包含约 2270 个文件、60 万行代码的证明库，并以 comparator 配置限定仅允许三条标准公理。仓库本身不含数据，论文给出的证书哈希尚未随仓库发布，附录 B 条件的严格验证依赖 128 位精度区间算术计算。

Why it matters：这是 AI 辅助数学形式化在千禧年难题级问题上的重要工程实践，对形式化验证与 AI for Math 读者具有直接参考价值。
